lines.en: I walk over with a fridge on my back.

lines.zh: 冰箱门随着我的步子晃。
lines.en: The fridge door swings with my steps.
My long legs pause between steps.
I raise my head, mouth still moving.
Sand kicks up as I go.
I shift the fridge on my back.
Something rattles inside the fridge.
I come toward you slowly.
My neck is long; I look both ways.

lines.zh: 我踩到一个坑，歪了一下。
lines.en: I step in a hole and lurch.
I right the fridge.
I continue on.
I stand while the fridge hums.
I open the fridge and peek in.
It is cold inside.
I close the door.
My bare feet sink into the sand.
I stand still, my breath cold.
I am looking for shade.
The sun makes my head swim.
I check the fridge again.
I press the seal shut.
My hump shifts.
I huff out hot air.
Sand blows into my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把背上的冰箱挪了挪位。
lines.en: I shift the fridge on my back.
I watch the ripples in the far sand.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子弯下来。
lines.en: I bend my neck to look at you.
Would you like something cold?
What I carry is heavy.
Have you seen a walking fridge?
I burp, and it is cold air.
I want to find somewhere to rest.
You are standing in the middle of the sand road.
My tongue is a little dry.
Do you want to sit a while?
Do not touch my fridge.
I have walked the desert a long time.
I stand with my forelegs crossed.
I bend my long neck to one side.
I step back and the fridge sways.
I steady the load.

lines.zh: 扛着整台冰箱，腿有点打颤。
lines.en: Hauling a whole fridge leaves my legs shaking.
Cold air leaks out with a hiss.
I push up on my legs.
You knocked my hump crooked.
Ow! You've knocked my hump crooked!
Who said you could hit me? I hold grudges.
Is that water in your hand?
I am very thirsty.
I do not eat; I only drink.
Give me a little.

lines.zh: 这点麦子，塞不满我的牙。
lines.en: That wheat won't fill my teeth.
There is ice in the fridge.
Would you like a piece?
I set the cup on my back.
You hit me and the fridge door swings open.
A few ice cubes fall out.
I shut the door quickly.
My long legs hold firm.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的膝盖，退开了。
lines.en: You hit my knee and stagger back.
Dust flies at the impact.
The load on my back sways.
I catch a rock beside the road.
Even crouching, I am taller than you.
There are no others of my kind in the desert.
I walk the desert alone with my fridge.
It is more reliable than company.

lines.zh: 我打开门，里面还是凉的。
lines.en: I open the door; still cold.
I rest my head against it.
Sand patters on the fridge.
I get up again.
The road is still long.
I look at the horizon.
I set off again.
Bend down and pick it up.
Things on the sand are hot.
I put it in the fridge.
It will keep longer this way.
I open the door and put it on the bottom shelf.
I look; it may already be spoiled.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，放进背上的箱。
lines.en: I pick it up and stow it in the box on my back.
Left here it would be buried.
I nudge it with my foot.

lines.zh: 十六个麦子加五张皮，换我。
lines.en: Sixteen wheat and five hides get you me.
You knocked my fridge over.
Turning slowly — the cold arrives first.
My neck goes taut.
I raise a foreleg.

lines.zh: 我在沙漠里很久没打过架。
lines.en: I have not fought in the desert for a long time.

lines.zh: 我把冰箱往背上颠了颠。
lines.en: I settle the fridge on my back.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子慢慢弯下来。
lines.en: My long neck bends down slowly.

lines.zh: 你退到沙丘后面也没用。
lines.en: Dune or not, it will not help.

lines.zh: 麦子和皮革换来的高个子。
lines.en: A tall one, traded for wheat and leather.
My mouth is dry.
I will use my hooves.
My shadow is much longer than yours.
The sand will slow you.
I lower my head slowly and stare at you.
My stride is longer than yours.
I go around the dune.
I kick up a sheet of sand.
Sand gets in your eyes.
Two steps and I'm where you stand.
My fridge rattles.
You will falter on the slope.
The sand burns your feet.
You look back again.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩得很慢，很重。
lines.en: My hooves come down slow and heavy.
I lift a foot.
I swing my neck.
I swing the fridge at you.
That one used my legs.
I huff hot air in your face.
I raise my forelegs again.
My stomp leaves a pit.
Cold? My slap is colder!
Don't run. Let me greet you properly.

lines.zh: 我背着一台冰箱从沙丘后走出来。
lines.en: I come over the dune with a fridge on my back.

lines.zh: 十六个小麦和五张皮换来的我。
lines.en: Sixteen wheat and five leather bought me.
Sand fills my shoes at once.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的是太阳。
lines.en: The first thing I see is the sun.
I settle the fridge.
The fridge starts humming.
I lift my head and sniff the air.
It is too hot here.

lines.zh: 十六个小麦，五张皮革，就是我。
lines.en: Sixteen wheat and five leather; that's me.
I head toward the wind.
I lick my cracked mouth.
A new day begins.

lines.zh: 我背上的箱门响了一声。
lines.en: The door on my back clicks once.

lines.zh: 火烤着我，我身上的凉气都散了。
lines.en: Fire heats me and the cold drains away.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，冰箱砸在背上。
lines.en: I roll down the dune and the fridge lands on my back.

lines.zh: 水一直漫上来，我伸长脖子。
lines.en: The water rises and I stretch my neck up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，冰箱门飞了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and the fridge door flies off.
Frost forms on the arrow shaft.

lines.zh: 一阵光打来，我的眼睛睁不开。
lines.en: A flash of magic and I cannot open my eyes.
Thirst glues my tongue to my mouth.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，沙子玻璃化了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and it turns to glass.

lines.zh: 虚空里更冷，可没有冰箱。
lines.en: The void is colder still, and there is no fridge.
